title: From Research to Reality — AR/VR Entrepreneurship Opportunities for Sri Lankans
description: I'm speaking at an IEEE Entrepreneurship, Sri Lanka Section session exploring how AR/VR research can become real-world entrepreneurial opportunities, covering the AR/VR startup landscape and opportunities for Sri Lankan innovators. Open to anyone interested in entrepreneurship in AR/VR. 22 September 2026, 3.30 PM onwards, via Zoom; the Zoom link is shared with registered participants.

title: VRST 2026 — The Role of Display Type and Camera Perspective in Shaping VR Presence and Motion Sickness
description: I'm presenting my paper "The Role of Display Type and Camera Perspective in Shaping VR Presence and Motion Sickness" at the 32nd ACM Symposium on Virtual Reality Software and Technology (VRST 2026), held at the Research Institute of Electrical Communication, Tohoku University, Sendai, Japan, 16-18 November 2026. My presentation slot is still to be confirmed by the organisers.

title: ICITR 2026 — Workshop 01: Designing Shared Worlds Across Distance
description: I'm leading Workshop 01 of ICITR 2026 — the 11th International Conference on Information Technology Research (1–2 December 2026), organised by the Information Technology Research Unit at the University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka. "Designing Shared Worlds Across Distance: What Multiplayer AR Research Taught Me" explores the design and development of location-based multiplayer AR games, and how augmented reality becomes a core gameplay mechanic that connects remote players. Planned as an online session; date and time to be announced by the organisers.

title: NZGDC 2026 — Designing Shared Worlds Across Distance
description: I'm speaking at NZGDC 2026 (30 Sep – 3 Oct, Auckland) on "Designing Shared Worlds Across Distance: Lessons from Multiplayer AR Game Research" — real-time connections across distance, bridging places and people, and designing for presence, engagement and trust in multiplayer AR. 1 October 2026, 3:00–3:30 PM, NZ International Convention Centre, Auckland.

title: CODE with WIE 2026 — Workshop 01: Architecting the Augmented Tomorrow
description: Workshop 01 of CODE with WIE 2026, hosted by IEEE Women in Engineering Sri Lanka — exploring the technologies shaping the future and how innovation is transforming tomorrow's world, drawn from research in immersive technologies, software product engineering and game design. Online via Google Meet.

title: Research Visit to Tohoku University — Building an NZ–Japan AR Collaboration
description: Prof. Rob Lindeman and I (HIT Lab NZ, University of Canterbury) visited the Interactive Content Design Lab at the Research Institute of Electrical Communication (RIEC), Tohoku University, Sendai, Japan. We presented our research on location-based augmented reality and immersive interaction, and explored a joint research project bridging New Zealand and Japan.

title: Selected for Falling Walls Lab Aotearoa New Zealand 2024
description: One of nineteen researchers and innovators chosen from across Aotearoa New Zealand and the Pacific to pitch a breakthrough idea in three minutes at Falling Walls Lab Aotearoa New Zealand 2024, organised by Royal Society Te Apārangi. Pitch: "Breaking the Wall of Loneliness through Play" — how location-based augmented reality games can bring people together and ease loneliness through shared experiences.

title: Talking AR Game Design on the National Stage — NZGDC 2023
description: New Zealand Game Developers Conference, 2023. A panel of New Zealand augmented reality developers for the first-ever AR Game Dev Rant at NZGDC — a candid, fast-paced conversation about what it really takes to design and ship location-based AR experiences, alongside Evie, Melanie and Devi. (Exact date not published on-site; year only.)
